description: Dependency update pull requests for wordpress-idx: the sidecar's npm packages and the Dockerfile's base images every night, the plugin's development tools (npm and Composer) and the GitHub Actions workflows once a month, on the shared preset of ioanalytica/renovate-config (schedule, minimum release age, DCO, review requests, the label decision). CONTRIBUTING.md says what the bot updates.

customManagers.description: Tool versions of the workflows, an env *_VERSION under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line.

packageRules.description: The sidecar's npm packages (app/) run in the image: minor and patch updates in one pull request a week, a new major in a pull request of its own.
What the image is built from. The sidecar's version and changelog entry follow at the next release.
prBodyNotes: This changes the sidecar image: add a line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md before merging.

packageRules.description: The plugin's linters (ESLint, Stylelint, Prettier) do not reach the packaged plugin: every update, majors included, in one pull request a month.
The plugin's PHP development tools (PHPUnit, PHPCS with the WordPress standards, polyfills): every update, majors included, in one pull request a month.
PHPUnit 9 is the last series that runs on PHP 7.4, which the plugin supports and its tests run on.
The workflows: actions, runner images, the Node.js they set up and their service containers, every update in one pull request a month.

The MySQL that the test jobs start as a service is the series the tests are meant to cover: a new one is a deliberate move, its pull request carries the label decision. A group of its own, so that the decision does not hold the other workflow updates, and a new major apart from a new minor, so that either can be merged without the other.
A new digest under the same version means a release tag was moved: the preset labels it decision. A group of its own, for the same reason.

The preset this file extends, and the workflow pin-checksums.yml of ioanalytica/renovate-config once a hash pin brings it, move in one pull request. The preset has this group too, but its rules come before this file's: here, after the groups of the workflows, it wins.
The Renovate that renovate-config.yml runs, once a month: Renovate releases most days.
